message:
You know, I’ve always prided myself on being the gloriously over-prepared person in my family. When a storm brews on the horizon, I don’t just check the weather; I make sure I’ve got snacks, water, and my favorite blanket ready to go. It’s like a little cozy retreat waiting to happen! 

I recently stumbled upon a great resource that offers some practical tips for staying safe in extreme heat. It’s amazing how a little knowledge can turn a potential hassle into a calm afternoon with a book. 

What’s your go-to tip for staying cool or prepared during a storm? I’d love to hear your tricks!
